QUOTE: "1. Split the pattern at the first `:`. 2. Left side: `fnmatch` against the tool name, e.g. `filesystem.*`. 3. Right side, if present: `fnmatch` against `tool:<argvalue>`." and "`git.commit` | that tool only, any args (no colon)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, a split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a colon-less pattern matches on the tool name alone.
